description: This file defines constants, structures, macros, and function prototypes for handling IEEE 1905 CMDU messages within the RdkEasyMeshController project. It includes message type definitions, structure for CMDU data, and API functions for parsing, forging, comparing, and freeing CMDU messages.

methods.name: parse_1905_CMDU_from_packets
methods.description: Parses a list of packet streams into a CMDU structure, extracting TLVs based on message type.

methods.name: forge_1905_CMDU_from_structure
methods.description: Creates packet streams from a CMDU structure, possibly fragmenting if size exceeds maximum.

methods.name: free_1905_CMDU_structure
methods.description: Recursively frees memory allocated for a CMDU structure and nested TLVs.

methods.name: free_1905_CMDU_packets
methods.description: Frees memory associated with packet streams returned by forge_1905_CMDU_from_structure.

methods.name: compare_1905_CMDU_structures
methods.description: Compares two CMDU structures for data equality.

methods.name: visit_1905_CMDU_structure
methods.description: Traverses a CMDU structure and applies a callback to each element.

methods.name: convert_1905_CMDU_type_to_string
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a CMDU message type.
